project.name: PracticeTakes
project.description: Practice Takes is an early cross-platform desktop music-practice application focused on live microphone analysis, with plans to grow into a more complete digital audio workstation. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
